pairs: Ascendit ergo Moyses de campestribus Moab super montem Nebo,
Therefore, Moses ascended from the plains of Moab onto Mount Nebo,
in verticem Phasga contra Jericho:
to the top of Pisgah, opposite Jericho.
ostenditque ei Dominus omnem terram Galaad usque Dan,
And the Lord revealed to him the entire land of Gilead, as far as Dan,
et universum Nephthali,
and all of Naphtali,
terramque Ephraim
and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh,
et Manasse,
and the entire land of Judah,
et omnem terram Juda usque ad mare novissimum,
even to the furthest sea,
et australem partem,
and the southern region,
et latitudinem campi Jericho civitatis palmarum usque Segor.
and the breadth of the plain of Jericho, the city of palms, as far as Zoar.
Dixitque Dominus ad eum:
And the Lord said to him:
Hæc est terra,
“This is the land,
pro qua juravi Abraham,
about which I swore to Abraham,
Isaac,
Isaac,
et Jacob,
and Jacob,
dicens:
saying:
Semini tuo dabo eam.
I will give it to your offspring.
Vidisti eam oculis tuis,
You have seen it with your eyes,
et non transibis ad illam.
but you shall not cross over to it.”
Mortuusque est ibi Moyses servus Domini,
And Moses, the servant of the Lord, died in that place,
in terra Moab,
in the land of Moab,
jubente Domino:
by order of the Lord.
et sepelivit eum in valle terræ Moab contra Phogor:
And he buried him in the valley of the land of Moab, opposite Peor.
et non cognovit homo sepulchrum ejus usque in præsentem diem.
And no man knows where his sepulcher is, even to the present day.
Moyses centum et viginti annorum erat quando mortuus est:
Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died.
non caligavit oculus ejus,
His eye was not dimmed,
nec dentes illius moti sunt.
nor were his teeth displaced.
Fleveruntque eum filii Israël in campestribus Moab triginta diebus:
And the sons of Israel wept for him in the plains of Moab for thirty days.
et completi sunt dies planctus lugentium Moysen.
And then the days of their wailing, during which they mourned Moses, were completed.
Josue vero filius Nun repletus est spiritu sapientiæ,
Truly, Joshua, the son of Nun,
quia Moyses posuit super eum manus suas.
was filled with the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands upon him.
Et obedierunt ei filii Israël,
And the sons of Israel were obedient to him,
feceruntque sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.
and they did as the Lord instructed Moses.
Et non surrexit ultra propheta in Israël sicut Moyses,
And no other prophet rose up in Israel like Moses,
quem nosset Dominus facie ad faciem,
one whom the Lord knew face to face,
in omnibus signis
one with all the signs and wonders,
atque portentis,
which he sent through him,
quæ misit per eum,
to perform in the land of Egypt,
ut faceret in terra Ægypti Pharaoni,
against Pharaoh,
et omnibus servis ejus,
and all his servants,
universæque terræ illius,
and his entire land,
et cunctam manum robustam, magnaque mirabilia, quæ fecit Moyses coram universo Israël.
nor one with such a powerful hand and such great miracles as Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
